findings.text: Converting generic integer type N to int via `n := int(nth)` causes truncation/overflow for large values or unsigned types. With nth=uint64(math.MaxUint64-2) on a 3-element slice, n becomes -3, the bounds check `-n > l` evaluates to `3 > 3` (false), and the function incorrectly returns collection[0] instead of an out-of-bounds error.
